name: FAA Licensed Spaceports By State
known_limitations: The list reports site-license holders and displayed expiration dates. A site license is not a vehicle mission authorization, booked range capacity, successful launch, local infrastructure completion, or commercial scale; stale displayed dates require separate confirmation.
source_owner: Federal Aviation Administration Office of Commercial Space Transportation
automation_notes: Track site-license renewals and expirations separately from launch or reentry licenses, environmental review, mission approval, and operations.
